title: Kissed Adventurous Russian Figs Skewers
description: A fresh and shaggy Russian dish featuring figs, this recipe is perfect for adventurous eaters, featuring a combination of sweet and savory flavors. It is satvik-friendly and cooked on a tava-griddle.
instructions: Preheat the tava-griddle over medium heat.
Thread a fig half onto a skewer, leaving a small space between each piece.
In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, balsamic vinegar, and honey.
Brush the mixture onto both sides of the figs.
Sprinkle chopped mint and basil onto the figs.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Place the skewers onto the preheated tava-griddle and cook for 2-3 minutes per side.
Serve the skewers warm, garnished with additional mint and basil if desired.
